channel.title: The Drill Down: New Orleans Saints
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Saints at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CIN -10 · O/U 50.5 | Model CIN 77% vs. market 82% | New Orleans must generate chunk plays after ranking 31st in explosive rate, against a Cincinnati defense that allows 9.2%. Chris Olave, who draws 45% of New Orleans' air yards, faces a Cincinnati pass defense ranked 23rd, though Tyler Shough must keep pace with Joe Burrow. Our model puts Cincinnati at 77% to the market's 82%, with the passing matchup and the starting quarterback pushing hardest toward the Bengals.

item.title: Week 11: Saints at Bears
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -11.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CHI 85% vs. market 82% | The Saints need pressure to slow Caleb Williams and a Chicago passing game ranked near the top of the league, yet New Orleans generates pressure on just 21% of dropbacks. Chris Olave absorbs 26% of New Orleans' targets and runs into a Chicago pass defense that ranks 11th, so his usage matters more than the matchup. Our model puts Chicago at 85%, a bit above the market, and the rushing matchup, worth 5.1 points, drives most of that lift.

item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 45% vs. market 50% | The fight in space decides this one: Carolina's defense ranks 1st in yards after catch over expected, while New Orleans' ranks 28th, so the Panthers must keep short throws from turning into chunk gains. Chris Olave soaks up 29% of New Orleans' targets and runs into a Carolina pass defense ranked 25th. Our model makes Carolina a 55% winner against a 50-50 market, driven chiefly by the rushing matchup.
